description_en: Queries the zones that are available for an Enterprise Edition transit router in a specified region
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterAvailableResource接口查询指定地域下企业版转发路由器支持的可用区信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-available-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --support-multicast false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterAvailableResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Enterprise Edition transit router is deployed.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to obtain region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only information about zones that support the multicast feature.

true: Yes.

  If you enable this feature and the ListTransitRouterAvailableResource operation returns an empty response, it indicates that Enterprise Edition transit routers in the current region do not support the multicast feature.

false (default): No
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询支持组播功能的可用区的信息。

true：是。

    开启查询功能后，如果ListTransitRouterAvailableResource接口返回结果为空，则表示当前地域的企业版转发路由器不支持组播功能。
false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: support_multicast

AvailableZones.description_en: A list of available zone IDs

items.description_en: The ID of an available zone

MasterZones.description_en: A list of primary zone IDs

items.description_en: The ID of a primary zone

SlaveZones.description_en: A list of secondary zone IDs

items.description_en:
The ID of a secondary zone.

Call the [DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html） operation to query information about the zone
items.description_zh:
备可用区ID列表。

您可以调用[DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html）接口查询可用区ID对应的可用区的信息

SupportMulticast.description_en: Indicates whether the returned zones support the multicast feature
SupportMulticast.description_zh: 是否为支持组播功能的可用区信息
